card.name: Legal citation numbers before dates
card.fires_on: Letters and digits inside official legal citations, such as OJ L295 or Act no. 11 of 1911, where a year or date comes next.

modes.label: EU Official Journal refs
modes.description: The OJ, L and digits of an Official Journal reference, just before a page and date.

modes.label: Act or ordinance number
modes.description: The word of or a digit after an act, ordinance or convention number, before the year.

card.writes: It favors number-word tokens like 编号, 号 and Strength, suggesting a citation or ID number slot.
card.plain: It fires inside legal reference numbers, like a law's number and the year that follows.
